'''Kevin''' (Japanese: '''ケビン''' ''Kevin'') is a character who appeared in ''[[M12|Arceus and the Jewel of Life]]''. 

==History==
[[File:Sheena & Kevin traveling outfits.png|thumb|left|250px|Kevin and Sheena during their travels]]
He and [[Sheena]] are the guardians of the {{DL|Michina Town|Michina Ruins}}. They are extremely interested in their town's mythology and travel extensively to research it, especially the impact that {{OBP|Arceus|M12}}'s awakening has on the three [[Pokémon of myth]]'s respective dimensions. They were present near the plateau of [[Alamos Town]] as it was returned to the proper dimension by {{mov|Palkia}} at the end of ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]'' and later visited the glacier near [[Ten'i Village]] to see [[Zero]]'s ship after it crashed during the climax of ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]''. 

Sheena and him explained the legend of [[Damos]] to {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} and was present when Arceus attacked [[Michina Town]]. While Sheena and the others [[Time travel|time traveled to the past]] thanks to {{mov|Dialga}}, he stayed behind and watched the fight between Arceus and the three Legendary Pokémon.
